support_desktop_pitch: Qafila is free, with no ads and no tracking. Support goes through a secure Stripe payment page (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card), opened in your browser.
downloads_footer: Files are saved to this folder without asking.
external_open_mail: Open this link in your email app?
external_open_tel: Open this number in your phone app?
page_crashed: This page stopped unexpectedly. Reload to try again.
scroll_desktop_footer: Fixed: the bar stays whole. Shrink: when you scroll down, only the domain remains; click it or scroll up to bring the bar back. Hide: the bar disappears when you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up or move the mouse to the edge. The page is never hidden under the bar.
fullscreen_notice: %1$s is now full screen · Press Esc to exit
fullscreen_notice_page: Full screen · Press Esc to exit
file_blocked: Files from this computer don't open in Qafila: a local page could read your other documents.
gallery_footer: Click a bar to use it; you can then fine-tune it in Customize.
bar_style_footer: Classic: solid color. Glass: translucent bar. Floating: a rounded bar away from the window edges.
download_risky: “%1$s” wants to download “%2$s” without you asking. This type of file can run code on your computer.
update_button_title: Qafila %1$s is ready: click to restart and install it
update_button_title_manual: Qafila %1$s is available: click to download it
update_auto_sub: Checks at launch and every 6 hours, downloads in the background
update_footer: To find out whether a new version exists, Qafila only contacts GitHub and sends no personal data. A downloaded version is also installed when you quit Qafila.
